decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher sits close to the firm's core postpress know-how, so it can interpret results and refine the product through its service and application expertise.

UV spot varnishing is farther from the firm's binding and cutting base and the firm does little visible research of its own, but it is a promoted flagship with a German premiere and a partner customer, so it is likely kept for now.
The sheet preparation module builds directly on the firm's modular finishing systems, so the existing knowledge supports assimilating feedback.
The B2 multifinisher is a flagship close to the core portfolio and fits the automation direction, so it is strongly supported by existing knowledge.
The hybrid saddle stitcher lies in the firm's established booklet-making domain, where its application know-how allows ongoing improvement.
The folding add-on is close to the core offer and has a documented customer installation integrating it into an inline workflow.
